clarified_intent.description: Validate the Flutter/Riverpod/A2UI showcase closure after stable Flutter host gates and iOS/Android smoke evidence promoted its bounded coverage from partial to implemented.

specification.constraint_source: KBD plan and change-specific evidence because .kbd-orchestrator/constraints.md is absent

target_state.description: A reproducible QA bundle with all bounded Flutter criteria supported, explicit exclusions retained, the frozen React rc.1 lane unchanged, and no registry mutation claim.
success_criteria: Stable Flutter 3.44.8 host gates and the retained 70-package/25-showcase test receipt remain hash-consistent.
The shared smoke flow passed on an iOS simulator and Android API 35 emulator without being described as physical-device certification.
All three stable golden hashes match and serious native accessibility certification is not claimed.
Coverage marks the Flutter showcase, platform evidence, and CRUD evidence implemented while durable persistence remains partial and universal Tauri remains planned.
The Dart public declaration ledger remains 81/81 and the private example does not create a public Flutter package surface.
Remote main remains the rehearsed React rc.1 source and this continuation records only a later patch Changeset.

unknowns: Physical-device and native assistive-technology behavior are not certified by this change.
The example's offline queue is in memory and does not prove durable persistence.
Registry, app-store, and external hosted-service authority remain outside this change.
